map.Barratt冲动性量表第11版(BIS-11, Patton 1995)，评估: Barratt Impulsiveness Scale, 11th edition (BIS-11, Patton 1995) assesses impulsive traits. 30 items, 4-point scale (1-4), with 11 reverse-scored items; total 30-120, divided into attention, motor and non-planning subscales. Higher total means stronger impulsivity.
map.BIS-11冲动性总分 = Σ30个条目；分注意、运动、非计划三因子；≤52低、: BIS-11 total impulsiveness = sum of 30 items; three factors: attention, motor, non-planning; <=52 low, 53-71 medium, >=72 high impulsiveness.
map.普通人群常见范围: Common range in the general population
map.冲动性极高，可能影响功能: Very high impulsiveness, may impair functioning
map.本量表为自助筛查工具，不能替代精神科专业诊断。反向题(标注\"反向\")中越同意: This scale is a self-help screening tool and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis. For reverse items (marked 'reverse'), stronger agreement means lower impulsiveness; scoring is auto-converted.
map.30 题 1–4（反向题 5−v）：注意冲动 22、运动冲动 24、非计划冲动: 30 items 1-4 (reverse: 5-v): attentional 22, motor 24, non-planning 19 -> total 65, above norm suggesting elevated impulsiveness, seen in ADHD/substance use etc.
map.三项分别 15/16/14 → 45，接近常模，冲动特征不突出。: Factors 15/16/14 -> 45, near norm; impulsiveness not prominent.
map.注意冲动（认知不稳）、运动冲动（行动不经思）、非计划冲动（缺乏前瞻），分项可定位: Attentional (cognitive instability), motor (acting without thinking) and non-planning (lack of forethought) impulsiveness; subscale scores locate intervention targets.
map.REV 列表题需 5−原始分后再汇总，脚本已按 REV 字典自动翻转。: REV-list items are scored as 5 minus raw before summing; the script auto-flips them via the REV dictionary.
map.冲动(BIS-11)行为量表评估器。医疗专业工具，基于权威医学标准，仅供参考。: Barratt Impulsiveness Scale (BIS-11). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
